incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT OPENED — Severity: P2 — Observability gap detected for runtime-proxy (eu-west-1). Trigger: alerts: runtime-proxy-missing-logs. Start: 2026-03-15T02:07:14Z. Page: @alice (oncall).

alice (oncall): I'm on it. Paging @bob (sre) for log pipeline checks. Quick customer impact? @dave (support)

dave (support): A few customers reported 502s to hosted inference, mainly low-volume tenants. Support has 3 tickets, escalating.

bob (sre): Checking vpc log-forwarder and log-sampling config. First glance: fluentd pods show restarts earlier this hour. Running `kubectl -n ops get pods -l app=fluentd -o wide` now.

bob (sre): logs show `write errors: EPIPE` around 02:05Z to log-collector.svc. Could be downstream backlog.

carol (observability): Dashboards show metric `ingest.events.total` drop ~02:04Z. Also noticed sampling rate changed for runtime-proxy -> sampling: 0.01 -> 0.001 in config rollout at 02:03Z. Was that an intentional change? @eve (eng-runtime)

eve (eng-runtime): I deployed a sampling tweak to reduce costs on low-traffic clusters. It rolled out via canary at 02:01Z. I didn't expect it to affect required logs. Reverting now.

alice (oncall): Thanks — if sampling was lowered, that explains missing logs. But we need handoff timeline and customer impact. @bob can you confirm log retention vs ingest?

bob (sre): Confirming: collector backlog + aggressive sampling = many RPC traces dropped. Collector's disk I/O spiked then OOM-killed one shard at 02:06Z. I'm restarting shard-2 now.

bob (sre): restart done. Logs flowing to collector but there is a ~2 min gap. Pushing patch to increase buffer and add backpressure metrics.

frank (pager): Taking the handoff in 10min — frank (pager) will coordinate post-02:20Z if needed.

alice (oncall): Note for timeline: deploy sampling change 02:01Z, collector shard OOM 02:06Z, alerts fired 02:07Z, restart 02:10Z, partial recovery 02:12Z. Add to RCA doc.

carol (observability): Also noticed dashboard `proxy:latency.p99` spiked 02:07-02:09Z for a subset of requests — could be retries due to missing logs/metrics used by routing. Attaching ad-hoc query output below.

carol (observability): ```sql
SELECT time_bucket('1m', ts) as minute, count(*) FROM proxy.requests
WHERE region = 'eu-west-1' AND code >= 500
GROUP BY minute ORDER BY minute DESC LIMIT 10;
```

dave (support): Copying customer ticket IDs: #3241, #3243, #3248. Tickets show 502s, start 02:06Z, resolved for most 02:13Z after retries.

eve (eng-runtime): Reverted sampling config at 02:11Z. Confirming revert finished 02:12Z. Will follow up with safer rollout + guardrails.

alice (oncall): Good. Action items: 1) Bob to increase collector buffer and adjust OOM threshold (in progress). 2) Eve to add rollout check for sampling impact. 3) Carol to capture ad-hoc queries for RCA. 4) Support to notify affected customers with incident note. Assign owners.

bob (sre): Patch applied to collector buffer, bump to 2Gi. Monitoring will alert if queue > 70% for 10m.

eve (eng-runtime): Adding a pre-rollout check: if `ingest.events.total` delta > -10% across canary -> abort. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/ops/pull/987

carol (observability): Saved snapshots of dashboards and query results. I'm missing some request-level logs between 02:05Z-02:09Z due to sampling, capturing traces we have. Will include timeline table in RCA.

dave (support): Notifying customers now with status update. Will include ETA and mitigation steps taken. Link to sent notices: https://support.redwood/status/1925001234

alice (oncall): Handoff to frank in 12m. If anything regresses, escalate to incident commander. @bob please add logs and commands you ran to the RCA thread.

bob (sre): Commands run:
```
kubectl -n ops delete pod fluentd-2
kubectl -n collector scale deployment collector-shard --replicas=3
```
Logs saved to /var/tmp/incident-1925001234/logs.tar.gz

frank (pager): Taking over. Summary for next shift: sampling rollback done, collector buffer increased, partial customer impact limited to ~7min. We'll run a follow-up to validate no data loss and propose permanent guardrails.

alice (oncall): Thanks all. Closing page for now; monitor for 30m then postmortem. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status -> mitigated (partial). Severity remained P2. Created RCA draft: https://docs.redwood/rca/1925001234
